title: Send files
heading: Send files to {{name}}
intro: Pick the photos or PDF you want to send. They go straight to the team you have been texting.
dead_link_body: It may have expired or already been replaced. Ask for a new one and we will text it over.
sent_body: The team can see what you sent now. You can send more if there is anything else.
too_many: That is more than can go in one upload. Remove a few, or send the rest afterwards.
failed: That did not go through. Check your connection and try again.
